sourceNote: Ideas adapted from successful projects on Solana and Ethereum for Sui. Each idea explains why Sui's primitives (PTBs, objects, Kiosk, zkLogin, Walrus) make the Sui version better than a straight port.

ideas.title: Token bonding curve launchpad (pump.fun for Sui)
ideas.summary: Fair launch platform where tokens start on a bonding curve. Graduates to DeepBook CLOB when liquidity threshold is met. No pre-mine, no snipe.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs handle atomic graduation from bonding curve to DeepBook pool. Sui objects track launch state per-token.
ideas.marketSignal: Pump.fun on Solana generated $500M+ in fees. No Sui-native bonding curve launcher exists.

ideas.title: NFT-collateralized lending (Blend for Sui)
ideas.summary: Lending protocol where Sui objects (NFTs, domains, memberships) serve as collateral. Kiosk transfer policies enforce liquidation rules.
ideas.fitForSui: Kiosk objects carry richer state than ERC-721. Transfer policies enforce liquidation at the protocol layer.
ideas.marketSignal: Blur Blend processed $1B+ in NFT loans. Sui's object model makes NFT collateral more composable.

ideas.title: CDP stablecoin backed by SUI and LSTs (DAI for Sui)
ideas.summary: Collateralized debt position protocol. Deposit SUI or liquid staking tokens, mint a decentralized stablecoin. Liquidation via DeepBook.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent individual vaults with rich state. DeepBook provides liquidation venue. PTBs handle mint/repay atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: MakerDAO (DAI) holds $8B+ TVL. Sui lacks a decentralized stablecoin protocol.

ideas.title: Compressed NFTs for mass-mint campaigns (cNFTs for Sui)
ideas.summary: Mass-mint millions of NFTs at near-zero cost using Walrus for metadata storage and Merkle proofs for ownership. Events, loyalty, and marketing use cases.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores metadata cheaply. Merkle proofs reduce on-chain storage. Sui objects represent proven ownership claims.
ideas.marketSignal: Solana cNFTs enabled 100M+ mint campaigns (DRiP, Helium). Sui has no mass-mint equivalent.

ideas.title: DeFi aggregator with PTB-powered atomic execution (Jupiter for Sui)
ideas.summary: Route trades across every Sui DEX in one atomic PTB. Split routes, multi-hop swaps, and limit orders. Best price guarantee.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs make multi-DEX routing atomic without custom router contracts. Sui's PTB composability is superior to EVM approve-then-swap.
ideas.marketSignal: Jupiter is Solana's #1 app by volume ($50B+ monthly). Sui has no dominant aggregator.

ideas.title: Decentralized social protocol with portable profiles (Lens for Sui)
ideas.summary: Social profiles, follows, and posts as Sui objects. Any frontend can render the social graph. Content stored on Walrus.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects carry social state that travels across apps. Walrus stores content. zkLogin handles user onboarding.
ideas.marketSignal: Lens (EVM) and Farcaster proved decentralized social demand. Sui's object model makes profiles more portable.

ideas.title: Dynamic NFTs with on-chain evolution (Solana xNFTs for Sui)
ideas.summary: NFTs whose metadata and visuals change based on on-chain events, time, or owner actions. Game items that level up. Art that evolves.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's mutable objects support in-place metadata updates. No need for off-chain metadata refresh. State changes are verifiable.
ideas.marketSignal: Dynamic NFTs (Async Art, Loot) proved collector demand. Sui's mutable objects make them native.

ideas.title: Peer-to-peer escrow marketplace (Paxful for Sui)
ideas.summary: P2P marketplace for buying and selling crypto with fiat. Escrow as Sui objects. Dispute resolution via multisig arbiters.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui escrow objects are first-class. zkLogin handles non-crypto user onboarding. Sponsored gas hides crypto complexity.
ideas.marketSignal: Paxful and Bisq process billions in P2P volume. Emerging markets drive demand for fiat-to-crypto.

ideas.title: Token launchpad with tiered access (Camelot for Sui)
ideas.summary: IDO platform with tiered allocations based on staking or reputation. Fair launch guarantees. Post-launch liquidity on DeepBook.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent allocation tiers. DeepBook provides post-launch liquidity. PTBs handle atomic claim-and-stake.
ideas.marketSignal: Camelot (Arbitrum), Raydium (Solana) launchpads are top DeFi apps. No Sui-native launchpad dominates.

ideas.title: MEV protection service for Sui transactions
ideas.summary: Service that routes user transactions to avoid sandwich attacks and front-running. Encrypted transaction submission via Seal, decrypted by validators.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal encrypts transaction intent. Sui's consensus ordering plus encrypted submission prevents front-running.
ideas.marketSignal: Flashbots on EVM protects $1B+ monthly. Sui MEV is nascent but will grow with volume.

ideas.title: Music NFT marketplace with streaming royalties (Sound.xyz for Sui)
ideas.summary: Artists mint music NFTs. Buyers earn streaming royalties proportional to ownership. Audio stored on Walrus. Royalty splits via PTBs.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores audio permanently. Kiosk enforces royalties on resale. PTBs distribute streaming payments to all holders.
ideas.marketSignal: Sound.xyz proved music NFT demand on EVM. Walrus makes audio storage viable on-chain.

ideas.title: NFT AMM with instant liquidity (Tensor for Sui)
ideas.summary: Automated market maker for NFTs. Instant buy and sell at algorithmic prices. Uses Kiosk for custody and transfer policy for royalty enforcement.
ideas.fitForSui: Kiosk objects with transfer policies make NFT AMM royalty-compliant by default. No EVM-style royalty bypass possible.
ideas.marketSignal: Tensor on Solana and Sudoswap on EVM proved NFT AMM demand. Sui Kiosk makes royalties enforceable.

ideas.title: On-chain game engine with composable assets (MUD for Sui)
ideas.summary: Framework for building fully on-chain games on Sui. Game state as Sui objects. Composable items that work across games. Real-time moves via shared objects.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model is naturally game-shaped. Shared objects handle real-time multiplayer state. Items travel between games natively.
ideas.marketSignal: MUD (EVM) and Bolt (Solana) proved on-chain game frameworks have developer demand.

ideas.title: Perpetual futures aggregator across Sui protocols
ideas.summary: Route perp orders across Bluefin, and other Sui perp protocols for best execution. Unified interface, split routing, cross-margin.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs route orders across multiple perp protocols atomically. Sui objects track aggregated positions.
ideas.marketSignal: DeFi perp volume exceeds $100B monthly across chains. Aggregation improves execution quality.

ideas.title: Real estate tokenization platform (RealT for Sui)
ideas.summary: Tokenize rental properties. Investors buy fractional ownership as Sui objects. Rent distributed via PTBs. Secondary trading on DeepBook.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent ownership shares with rich property metadata. PTBs distribute rent atomically. DeepBook enables secondary trading.
ideas.marketSignal: RealT on EVM tokenized $100M+ in property. Real estate tokenization is a $16T addressable market.

ideas.title: Restaking protocol for SUI stakers (EigenLayer for Sui)
ideas.summary: SUI stakers opt in to secure additional services (oracles, bridges, rollups). Earn extra yield. Slashing for misbehavior.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent restaking positions. Capabilities scope slashing authority. Parallel execution handles reward distribution.
ideas.marketSignal: EigenLayer holds $15B+ TVL on ETH. Restaking is the top DeFi narrative of 2025-2026.

ideas.title: Licensed sports collectibles with game moments (NBA Top Shot for Sui)
ideas.summary: Video moments from sports events minted as Sui objects. Stored on Walrus. Marketplace via Kiosk. Licensed with revenue share to athletes.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus stores video clips permanently. Kiosk enforces royalties on resale. zkLogin onboards sports fans without wallets.
ideas.marketSignal: NBA Top Shot peaked at $1B+ in sales. ONE Championship track at Overflow 2026 targets sports collectibles.

ideas.title: Staking derivatives marketplace (LSDfi for Sui)
ideas.summary: Trade, lend, and leverage liquid staking tokens. Concentrated DeFi primitives for afSUI, haSUI, and other LSTs.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs compose LST operations atomically. Sui objects represent individual LST positions with rich state.
ideas.marketSignal: LSDfi on ETH holds $10B+ TVL (Lybra, Pendle). Sui LST ecosystem is early but growing.

ideas.title: Subscription NFTs with auto-renewal (Unlock for Sui)
ideas.summary: Membership NFTs that expire and auto-renew via on-chain payment. Access gated by Seal. Content stored on Walrus.
ideas.fitForSui: Seal subscription policies handle access control with expiry. Walrus stores gated content. Sui clock triggers renewal.
ideas.marketSignal: Unlock Protocol on EVM proves subscription NFT demand. Sui Seal makes expiry and renewal native.

ideas.title: Protocol analytics dashboard (Token Terminal for Sui)
ideas.summary: Track revenue, TVL, active users, and financial metrics for every Sui protocol. Exportable reports for investors and governance.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model and event system provide richer protocol metrics than account-based chains.
ideas.marketSignal: Token Terminal and DeFi Llama have millions of monthly users. No Sui-specific analytics platform dominates.

ideas.title: Web3 email with wallet-based addressing (Mailchain for Sui)
ideas.summary: Send and receive email using Sui addresses or SuiNS names. Messages stored on Walrus. Encrypted with Seal. No centralized email server.
ideas.fitForSui: SuiNS provides human-readable addresses. Walrus stores messages. Seal encrypts per-recipient.
ideas.marketSignal: Mailchain on EVM proved wallet-based email demand. SuiNS makes Sui addresses readable.

ideas.title: Full-stack DAO tooling suite (Aragon for Sui)
ideas.summary: Create and manage DAOs on Sui. Treasury management, proposal voting, delegation, payroll, and token gating. All in one platform.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent DAO state natively. Capabilities scope roles. PTBs execute governance actions atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: Aragon and DAOhaus serve 5K+ DAOs on EVM. Sui has no comprehensive DAO tooling.

ideas.title: Learn-to-earn platform for Sui developer education
ideas.summary: Complete Move tutorials and quizzes to earn tokens. Progress tracked on-chain. Verified credentials as Sui objects. Sponsored by ecosystem protocols.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent learning credentials. Sponsored gas lets learners start without tokens. zkLogin handles onboarding.
ideas.marketSignal: RabbitHole and Layer3 on EVM distributed $50M+ in learn-to-earn rewards. Sui developer growth needs incentive.

ideas.title: Soulbound achievement tokens for on-chain milestones
ideas.summary: Non-transferable achievement tokens for on-chain milestones: first swap, first LP, first NFT mint, governance participation. Portable reputation across Sui apps.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model supports non-transferable objects natively. No wrapping hacks needed like EVM soulbound tokens.
ideas.marketSignal: Galxe and POAP serve millions of users on EVM. Soulbound tokens are a growing identity primitive.
